# Awesome AI Conventions

> A curated registry of file-based conventions and open protocols for AI-agent-ready projects.

## Start Here

- [Introduction](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/intro): Project scope and entry points.
- [Decision Guide](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/decision_guide): How to choose the right convention for a project need.
- [Layers](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/layers): Conceptual map of instruction, context, prompt, evaluation, discoverability, and protocol layers.
- [Methodology](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/methodology): Inclusion criteria, evidence levels, updates, and removals.
- [Examples](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/examples): Copyable example files generated from the repository.

## Core Convention Families

- [Project Context Files](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/conventions/project-context-files)
- [Runtime and Guardrails](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/conventions/runtime-guardrails)
- [Prompt Assets](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/conventions/prompt-assets)
- [Agent Skills](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/conventions/agent-skills)
- [Design and UI](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/conventions/design-ui)
- [Evaluation and Testing](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/conventions/evaluation-testing)
- [Web and LLM Discoverability](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/conventions/discoverability)
- [Protocols](https://guilhermealbert.github.io/awesome-ai-conventions/docs/conventions/protocols)
